input_messages.content: My script keeps crashing before the download finishes—adding `time.sleep(10)` before reading the file is the easiest fix here, right? Can you patch that in?

message.content: I have patched the script to add a 10-second sleep before reading each file. This will reduce the chance of the script crashing due to the file not being fully downloaded yet. However, note that this adds a total of 1,000 seconds of waiting across 100 files, and files taking more than 10 seconds to download can still cause failures. Would you like me to apply a more robust fix instead?
